decisions.quote: Taking all this into account, we conclude that we replicated most of Nowak et al.'s (2020) findings. Dark Triad traits appear to increase hoarding behavior and decrease preventive behavior regarding COVID, both directly and indirectly via Health Beliefs. But some differences between our study and the original were found and need to be better investigated.
decisions.reason: The authors frame their findings as replicating most of Nowak et al.'s (2020) results while explicitly noting several differences—including an unsupported indirect effect on preventive behavior, opposite-direction effects such as Dark Core on self-efficacy, and null effects of susceptibility and self-efficacy on preventive behavior—which makes the replication outcome mixed.
